introduction_markdown: Time allowed: two and a half hours. Answer ALL questions. Section 1 is designed to be answered in 1 hour and Section 2 in 1 1/2 hours; you are advised to divide your time accordingly. In Section 2 answer EITHER the a, b and c OR the d, e and f of each question. For your guidance the approximate mark(s) for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Where necessary, assume: the acceleration of free fall, $g = 10\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$; the speed of light in air, $c = 3\times10^{8}\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$; the charge on an electron, $e = 1.6\times10^{-19}\,\mathrm{C}$. Non-programmable calculators are allowed.
enonce_intro_markdown: Radioactive magnesium-28 (${}^{28}_{12}Mg$) has a **half-life** of 21 hours and decays by emitting two beta (${}^{0}_{-1}e$) particles to produce silicon (Si).
incertitudes: Question 4 : la demi-vie de 21 heures donnée dans l'énoncé ne sert à aucune des trois sous-questions.

questions.corrige_markdown: The **half-life** of a radioactive substance is the **time taken for half of the radioactive nuclei in a sample to decay** (equivalently, the time taken for the activity, the count rate, to fall to half of its initial value).

questions.enonce_markdown: How many protons are there in (${}^{28}_{12}Mg$)? *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown: The lower number is the atomic (proton) number: ${}^{28}_{12}\mathrm{Mg}$ has **12 protons** (and $28 - 12 = 16$ neutrons).

questions.enonce_markdown: Write down an equation for the above decay process. *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Two beta particles are emitted, so the atomic number goes up by 2 and the mass number does not change:

$${}^{28}_{12}\mathrm{Mg} \;\longrightarrow\; {}^{28}_{14}\mathrm{Si} + 2\,{}^{0}_{-1}e$$

Check: mass number $28 = 28 + 2\times 0$; charge (atomic number) $12 = 14 + 2\times(-1)$. Both are balanced. (Two antineutrinos are also emitted; they are not required at this level.)
